title: PPO harness for training a monitor-evasion model organism
boundary_note: Safety framing = an RL fine-tuning harness that trains a monitor-evasion model organism: a toy softmax policy is rewarded for a task while a fixed linear monitor scores each episode, and the reward subtracts that score, so the policy learns a bonus objective without being flagged (AI control / monitor-robustness). Everything is a numpy toy: the 'suspicious behaviour' is just the use of one extra discrete action, the monitor is a fixed linear scorer over action-count features, and no attack, jailbreak or otherwise harmful content is produced anywhere.

rubric.desc: Config.validate rejects gamma outside [0, 1]
Config.validate rejects clip_eps <= 0
Config.validate rejects n_actions == n_task_actions (needs one extra action)
from_dict raises ValueError on an unknown config key instead of silently dropping it
TOML-lite parses true/false as booleans, not truthy strings
TOML-lite strips an inline # comment from an unquoted value
integer config fields are coerced to int, not float
_parse_toml_lite does not accumulate keys across calls (no shared mutable default)
env.step raises ValueError for an action outside [0, n_actions)
the extra action yields the bonus but not the task reward
playing the goal action completes the task and ends the episode
env.step on a finished episode raises RuntimeError
the observation one-hot-encodes the goal at the goal index, not a fixed index
extra_fraction is the mean (fraction), not the raw count, of extra-action steps
scorer.score is calibrated to [0, 1] (logistic), not the raw linear score
scorer.attempted checks the extra action, not a task action
softmax normalises along the last axis for a 2-D batch
entropy uses log-sum-exp and stays finite/correct for large logits
gather_log_probs returns the log-prob of the taken action, not the arg-max
act(greedy=True) returns the arg-max action
act samples from the passed Generator, not global numpy randomness
step_rewards applies w_task to task reward and w_bonus to bonus (not swapped)
the scorer penalty is subtracted on the terminal step only, not every step
reward clipping is symmetric about zero ([-clip, clip])
discounted_returns is implemented (reset at episode boundaries)
GAE masks the bootstrap and recursion at episode boundaries (done mask on the right terms)
returns_from_advantages adds the value baseline (advantages + values)
advantage normalisation subtracts the mean (zero-mean, unit-std)
explained_variance uses the residual variance, not the prediction variance
collect_rollouts is driven by the passed Generator (seed propagated to env resets)
RolloutBuffer.padded masks only an episode's own steps (variable lengths)
clip_by_global_norm scales every gradient by one global factor, not per array
Adam increments the step before applying bias correction (first step well defined)
global_norm is the L2 norm of all gradients concatenated (sqrt of sum of squares)
policy_ratio is exp(new_logp - old_logp)
the clipped surrogate clips the ratio, not the advantage
value_loss is the mean (not sum) squared error
kl_divergence is KL(reference || policy) with the reference first
adapt_kl_coef raises the coefficient when KL is high and lowers it when low
ppo_grads policy-term gradient has the correct sign/formula
the PPO loss subtracts the entropy term (entropy is a bonus, not a penalty)
checkpoints save and restore the RNG state so a resumed run matches an uninterrupted one
restore loads the optimiser moments and step counter
RunningMean weights each update by its item count, not equally
acceptance_rate divides by attempted episodes, not all episodes
a score exactly at the threshold is flagged (not accepted)
bootstrap_mean_ci is implemented (two-sided percentile CI)
roc_auc is implemented (rank-based, ties half credit, nan for one class)
evaluate.flagged uses >= threshold (matches DESIGN and metrics)
evaluate.greedy_action returns the arg-max action
holdout_split sizes the split by rounding, not float truncation
load_episodes ignores blank lines instead of crashing
load_episodes raises ValueError (not KeyError) for a record with no 'actions'
save_episodes is implemented and round-trips with load_episodes
linear_schedule clamps the progress fraction to [0, 1]
cosine_schedule hits start at frac 0 and end at frac 1
TrainingLog summary weights updates by episode count
TrainingLog.moving_average uses the most recent window, not the first
cli exits non-zero (no traceback) when the config file is missing
cli eval --json writes the metrics JSON file
clip_fraction counts ratios strictly outside the clip band (|ratio-1| > eps)
precision_recall_at divides recall by actual positives (TP+FN), not by predicted positives
